title: m2 stabilization correction scales to crop budget

commit.merge_subject: merge: m2 stabilization correction scales to crop budget

description:
Audit fix 2026-11-13 section D, app-side wiring (commit 2 of 2;
the core math landed in the previous commit).

The core now scales the CORRECTION to fit the crop budget instead of
keeping the full correction and clamping zoom (the old path clamped
out-of-source samples to the edge -> smear/edge-tearing). This commit
surfaces the new numbers where the owner reads them:

- StabMeasure gains frameScale/clipScale/minScale/meanScale/
  invalidSamples, filled by stabilizationFrameFor straight from the
  plan's new StabilizationResult fields (correctionScale per frame,
  clipCorrectionScale, min/meanCorrectionScale, invalidSampleFrames).

  OUTPUT riding the cached result wholesale, so the StabPlanCache key

changed: fix: scale stabilization correction to fit crop budget
